rows.actualDefect: VF42 measured erased official choice appearances and route-indistinguishable insert bytes. The appearance loss was already repaired by b724e9353, but both current routes still wrote zero insert values: the builder classified every insert control unwritable even though participant FACTS checkboxes are separately named from court FINDINGS and the governed route plus held dates settle a narrow subset.
rows.correction: The finalizer now marks Check Box19, Check Box25 from governed route/date facts. Check Box19 is marked only on the arrest/no-charges route; Check Box25 is marked where held filing and latest arrest/disposition dates prove at least one year. Check Box15 remains blank because no-charges does not prove prosecutor declination; the multi-outcome Section 1 disposition choices remain blank; all eight even-numbered court FINDINGS controls remain blank. Guidance and field maps disclose each premark and every handback. The b724 source-appearance path remains exact.
